data.narrative:
Flock Safety, a Series G defense and security company, carries a current post-money valuation of $7.5B following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. The peer universe consists of 11 same-sector comparables spanning similar valuation tiers, including 8 private firms (Shield AI at $12.7B Series G, Saronic at $9.2B Series D, Helsing at $18.0B Series D) and 2 public references.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling uses the $7.5B last post-money as a base and applies a 1.25x multiplier typical of Series G step-ups, yielding $9.4B. Peer-median triangulation across the 11-company comparable set produces a median of $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.1B to $18.0B. The peer median sits notably below the current valuation, reflecting either upside positioning within the cohort or potential valuation recalibration risk.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $3.7B (low) to $10.8B (high), with a median of $6.9B. The $7.5B current valuation sits above the two-method median but well within the high end of the derived range. Key uncertainties include whether the peer median adequately reflects Flock Safety's operational performance relative to comparables, and whether stage-progression multiples remain stable given current venture market conditions. The wide peer range ($2.1B–$18.0B) underscores substantial valuation dispersion within the sector.
